summary_en: As of 13 August 2026, a total of 13 cases of diphtheria and two deaths have been reported. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on diphtheria.

Between 1 January and 23 August 2026, a total of 16,997 cases of diphtheria and 596 deaths have been reported. Most cases have been reported from Kano, Bauchi, Katsina, Borno and Sokoto states. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on diphtheria.

As of 28 September 2026, 125 locally acquired cases of chikungunya have been identified in France, in Tarn, Lot, Gard (Occitanie), Gironde, Landes (Nouvelle-Aquitaine), Val-de-Marne (Ile-de-France) and Var (Provence-Alpes-Cote d'Azur). Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on chikungunya.

As of 26 September 2026, 8,067 confirmed Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) cases and 3,901 deaths have been reported in seven provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and South Ubangi. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on Ebola disease.

In 2026, up to 23 September, two locally acquired human cases of West Nile virus have been reported in Kosovo, in two areas. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

title_en: West Nile virus in North Macedonia
summary_en: In 2026, up to 23 September, 69 locally acquired human cases of West Nile virus have been reported in North Macedonia, in five areas. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

In 2026, up to 23 September, 91 locally acquired human cases of West Nile virus have been reported in Romania, across 22 areas. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

As of 21 September 2026, 117 autochthonous cases of West Nile virus have been recorded in Provence-Alpes-Cote d'Azur, Occitanie, Ile-de-France, Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, Pays de la Loire and Centre-Val de Loire. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

In 2026, up to 23 September, four locally acquired human cases of West Nile virus have been reported in Germany. Cases have been reported from Berlin, Leipzig Kreisfreie Stadt and Rhein-Pfalz-Kreis. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

In 2026, up to 23 September, 44 cases of West Nile virus, including 5 deaths, have been reported in the Netherlands. Cases have been reported from South Holland, Utrecht, North Holland, North Brabant, Gelderland and Overijssel provinces. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on West Nile virus.

As of 22 September 2026, a total of 47 confirmed locally acquired dengue cases have been reported for 2026 in Italy. The cases have been reported in Puglia (13), Tuscany (31), Lombardy (2), Campania (1) regions of Italy. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

As of 17 September 2026, 37 cases of hepatitis A have been reported from four states: Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York and Pennsylvania. Cases are associated with consumption of raw/undercooked shellfish imported from Ecuador. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on hepatitis A.

As of 21 September 2026, 7,773 confirmed Ebola disease (Bundibugyo virus) cases and 3,759 deaths have been reported in seven provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and South Ubangi. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on Ebola disease.
Between 6 and 12 September 2026, one case of locally acquired chikungunya was reported in Florida, USA. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on chikungunya.

On 17 September 2026, a locally acquired case of chikungunya was reported. This is the first locally acquired case of chikungunya in Hong Kong in 2026. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on chikungunya.
In August 2026, one new clade I mpox case was reported in Estonia. This is the first case of clade I mpox in Estonia. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on mpox.
In August 2026, one new clade I mpox case was reported in Iceland. This is the first case of clade I mpox in Iceland. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on mpox.
In August 2026, three new clade I mpox cases were reported in Malta. These are the first cases of clade I mpox in Malta. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on mpox.

Between 6 and 12 September 2026, 41 new cases of locally acquired dengue were reported in Florida, bringing the total for 2026 to 152. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on dengue.

On 17 September 2026, one fatal case of malaria was reported in Schwanheim district, Frankfurt, Germany. The case was one of two cases of malaria, resident in the Schwanheim district. The case was believed to have been infected by a mosquito introduced from an endemic area by aircraft to Frankfurt Airport and neither worked at the airport or had recent travel history. The latest infections and death brings the total to eight infections and three fatal cases. Please see our Topics in Brief article for further details on malaria.
